newsitem.title: USA: Port of Tacoma, Wash., reports 1996 income growth.
newsitem.headline: Port of Tacoma, Wash., reports 1996 income growth.

text.p: The Port of Tacoma on Monday reported earning an operating income of $9.8 million for 1996 on record operating revenues of $53.3 million.
The results represented a 4.8 percent increase over 1995's operating income of $9.4 million, the port said. Total net income for 1996 was $17.5 million, a 32 percent increase over net income in 1995.
"The port turned in a very respectable performance," Port Commission President Jack Fabulich said in a statement.
Cargo activity ended the year mixed, the port said.
Container volume totaled 1,073,471 twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs) in 1996, a 1.7 percent decrease from 1995's record of 1,092,087 TEUs, the port said.
Cargo tonnage remained stable in comparison to 1995 at about 15 million short tons, the port said.
